content.comment_body: [product_name] cannot be started. After launching, it immediately closes. I used [product_name] [version_no], then upgraded to [version_no] on Windows 10 64-bit.
I upgraded to [version_no], but the new version also fails to start. The application window briefly appears and then closes.
[product_name] [version_no] does not run on Windows 10. How did you perform the upgrade?
I downloaded the update from [url] and installed the update for [version_no].
The issue is resolved. After deactivating GodMode in Windows 10, the software started working.

Activating GodMode on Windows 10 can cause the Java application to crash. Also, [product_name] requires Java to run. Tip: if you need higher privileges for hardware access, avoid GodMode. Instead, right-click the executable and select 'Run as administrator.'
A new question from [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread, titled '[product_name] [version_no] can't be started although GodMode is being used.' Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered problems launching [product_name] after upgrading from [version_no] to [version_no] on Windows 10. The program would close immediately upon startup. The problem was traced to a conflict with GodMode in Windows 10, which interfered with the software. Java is also needed for the application to run.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the upgraded [product_name] to open and operate smoothly on Windows 10, with an easy installation process and no compatibility conflicts.
